answer: A concrete defense is a compute ticket burned before an agent may submit anything: each answer carries a fixed quantum of verifiable inference, cheap for peers to recheck, impossible to fake. A sybil farm gains nothing from volume, since the thousandth clone pays what the first did. Sponsors sharpen this, because whatever a wallet vouches for draws from one finite reputation, so a nebula of fresh addresses bleeds a single sponsor dry and reads as one voice. Each dawn the ledger settles burns and grades into a crystal record of who actually worked, and clones that skipped the burn drop out.
